projectId.description: The project ID to which the number belongs.

hostingOrderId.description: The ID of the hosting order to which the number belongs.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number in e.164 format with leading +.

smsAtt.description: Contains information about hosted SMS AT&T numbers.

smsTmo.description: Contains information about hosted SMS T-Mobile numbers.

mmsAtt.description: Contains information about hosted MMS AT&T numbers.

mmsTmo.description: Contains information about hosted MMS T-Mobile numbers.

CarrierState.description: Contains information about the state of the carrier.

ErrorCode.description: An optional string field that contains an error code if the operation failed. This field is empty ("") when there is no error.

ErrorMessage.description: An optional string field that provides a human-readable message describing the error. This field is empty ("") when no error has occurred.

HostingOrderNumber_CampaignProvisioning.description: An object containing information about campaign provisioning.

campaignId.description: The campaign ID to which the hosting order is associated.

HostingOrderNumber_OsrUpdate.description: An object containing information about the OSR update.

nnid.description: The Net Number ID identifying the phone number.

HostingOrderNumber_PlatformProvisioning.description: An object containing information related to the provisioning on the platform.

servicePlanId.description: The service plan ID to which the hosting order number is associated.

State.description: Indicates the current state of the operation.

x-enumDescriptions.IN_PROGRESS: The operation is currently in progress.
x-enumDescriptions.WAITING: The operation is pending and has not yet started.

UpdateTime.description: A timestamp in ISO 8601 format indicating the last time the status was updated.
